title: Quantifying Query Fairness Under Unawareness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on fairness related to demographic attributes such as geographic location, gender, and age of topic in information retrieval systems.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
